events.title: Levels made easier in Demo! - Duoshift v0.28.2
events.summary: Game is made easier now and all the levels are made easier for the players, except for the last boss levels. Some bugs are also fixed related to rewards.Now, 4 (or less) packs are randomly selected for each run bringing more variety and fun to each gameplay session. Unfortunately, this change requires resetting the saved profiles from the previous versions.Enjoy! :DJoin Duoshift DiscordSupport on Patreon

events.title: Duoshift is going into Next Fest!
events.summary: Duoshift is going into the Steam Next Fest! The store page content is updated and the demo is up as well.The game still has many issues especially related to difficulty but I strongly believe that it has a lot of potential. Please give me feedback and report the bugs so that, I can improve the game fast.I am very passionate about turn-based games and this passion came from Advance Wars series and Into the Breach game.
